findings.description: Security findings raised by the review (each an object: id, severity, finding, recommendation).

__path.description: Workspace-relative path of the artifact file, injected by the harness.

__kind.description: Artifact-kind discriminator injected by the harness; must equal x-artifact.kind.

__artifact_id.description: Stable artifact id injected by the harness.

__frontmatter_present.description: Harness assertion that YAML frontmatter was found and parsed.

__sections.description: Artifact body sections keyed by their `## ` heading (advisory; additionalProperties permitted).

Subject under review.description: Link / id of what is reviewed; restate the scope.

__body.description: Raw Markdown body, injected by the harness.

subject.description: The artifact id or path under review.

sources.description: Derivation provenance (narrowed subtype of the base contract's sources): refs to the upstream artifact(s) this security-review was built from. Allowed source kinds: feature, feature-enabler, story, story-enabler, adr, nfr-list, architecture-runway, architecture-vision.

stepOutcomes.description: Step outcome record — one entry per step that committed this artifact (see the stepOutcomes definition).

openItems.description: Clarification + challenge ledger entries (each an object: id, kind, raised_by, owner, blocking, status, ...).

stepOutcomes.description: Step outcome record. Every workflow step that commits this artifact appends exactly one entry, so the artifact itself carries the step's decision — including `confirmed`, `no-change` and `none` — and the agent's reply stays indicative.

step.description: `<workflow-slug>/<step-slug>` of the step that appended this entry.

outcome.description: written (created) | revised (content changed) | confirmed (reviewed, still valid) | no-change (out of scope on this run) | none (not needed; the artifact records that decision)

note.description: One line: what the step decided and why.
